order: The order, item by item: 1. Make creation-time identity capture fail CLOSED. `createCheckout` must resolve the checkout's canonical path itself at creation and, when that resolution fails, refuse the checkout and clean up the registration it just made — never store a lexical guess as the checkout's identity. The lexical fallback serves only already-gone swept paths. Pin the poisoned-realpath case with a regression test. 2. Replace the fixed sleeps in BOTH review-lane kill branches — the SIGTERM branch and the SIGKILL branch — with a poll of git's actual worktree registration lock, so each kill happens only once the checkout has finished registering. A slow checkout stays locked past any fixed delay, and a kill landing mid-registration leaves a locked worktree a single `--force` cannot reclaim. 3. Correct the CI records: the 9/9-green claim must name the PR-head run and state the superseded 09a824e run's true outcome, including the flake that fired in CI. 4. Record the R0-EX8 verdict verbatim. The tranche stays REVISE pending R0-EX9.
claims: Item 1 done. `createCheckout` resolves the canonical path itself right after `worktree add`; on failure it removes and prunes the registration, drops the parent dir, and returns a "cannot establish the checkout's canonical identity ... refusing rather than guessing (fail closed)" error. `realDir` is now normalized from that resolved path, never from the lexical `dir`. The poisoned-realpath regression is pinned in the verifier suite and passes. Item 2 done. Added `waitWorktreesUnlocked`, which polls `git worktree list --porcelain` for the `locked` marker on every linked worktree. Both kill branches of the review-lane suite's `case4` use it in place of the old `await sleep(250)`: each now asserts "checkout finished registering (lock cleared)" — one before the SIGTERM, one before the SIGKILL — so neither branch can land its signal mid-registration. Both new checks pass. Item 3 done. The dispositions record now names the PR-head run for the 9/9-green claim and states the superseded 09a824e run's true outcome, including the flake that fired in CI. Item 4 done. The R0-EX8 verdict is recorded verbatim; the tranche stays REVISE pending R0-EX9. VERIFICATION: verifier 99/99, review-lane 116/116 (run twice, both lock-condition checks green in each run), router 135/135, registry 31/31. Full CI-equivalent suite green, zero failures.
